title: CarrierOrder
description: Carrier order linked to country specific carriers that must be configured for this campaign.

carrierId.description: Carrier ID. Carrier IDs and names must be retrieved from /carriers endpoint.

carrierName.description: Carrier name. Carrier IDs and names must be retrieved from /carriers endpoint.

logs.description: All transitions applied to this carrier order

CarrierOrderLog.description: A transition applied to a carrier order

x-enumDescriptions.PENDING: Campaign has not been submitted yet to the carrier.
x-enumDescriptions.SUBMITTED: Campaign has been submitted to the carrier.
x-enumDescriptions.APPROVED: Campaign has been approved by carrier.
x-enumDescriptions.REJECTED: Campaign has not been approved by carrier.
x-enumDescriptions.PROVISIONED_BY_CARRIER: Short Code has been approved and configured on Sinch’s bind by this carrier.
x-enumDescriptions.PROVISIONED_BY_SINCH: Short Code has been set up on client’s account.
x-enumDescriptions.CLIENT_CERTIFICATION_REQUESTED: Campaign is ready to be tested by Sinch Team (to test opt-in and auto-responses such as HELP and STOP)
x-enumDescriptions.CARRIER_CERTIFICATION_REQUESTED: Campaign has passed Sinch testing and is pending certification/testing with the Carrier(not all carriers require this) where they will test opt-in and auto-responses for HELP and STOP.
x-enumDescriptions.CERTIFIED: Campaign has passed certification on this carrier and it is now LIVE! Ready for live traffic
x-enumDescriptions.DEPROVISIONED: Used when cancelling the connectivity part with this carrier.
x-enumDescriptions.CERTIFICATION_FAILURE: Testing failed. It can be due to keyword and auto-responses not set up as described in the campaign or the call to action is not live or not compliant.
x-enumDescriptions.CANCELLED: When the overall SC Campaign is not longer active with all carriers and the SC lease is cancelled.

Note.description: Notes used to contact customer and agents.

author.description: Author. It can be either a customer or an agent.
